nfts.name: The Ride
nfts.description:
We bought tickets
to a ride with no map,
no brakes,
and no guarantee
the tracks were finished.

Up feels permanent
until it isn't.

Down feels fatal
until it isn't.

Numbers flash.
Floors disappear.
Fortunes exist
for an afternoon.

Outside,
they watch from a distance.

They call it stupid.
A bubble.
A scam.
A waste of time.
A waste of money.

Maybe they're right.

But they can't feel
the stomach drop
when the chart goes vertical,
the silence when it doesn't,
the strange joy
of owning something
the rest of the world
doesn't understand yet.

We came for the money.

Some stayed for the art.
Some for the people.
Some for the absurdity.

Somewhere along the way
we stopped asking
where the ride was going.

The chaos became the point.

The volatility became the pulse.

And being misunderstood
became part of the admission price.

One day
the ride ends.

Everything does.

So hold your coins.
Hold your JPEGs.
Hold onto the bar
when the whole thing shakes.

Look around.

Laugh.

You paid for the ride.

You might as well
enjoy it.

There is an island in the south of my homeland Persia called Hengam. Most of the women living on this island wear a traditional clothing called "Borke" or "Batoole" to preserve their beauty from stranger men and keep it only for their husbands. They also tattoo their hands with henna plants, which they call "Lavender Henna."

This beautiful and dignified lady is named Eli. She lives on this island and lost her husband in the war. She is the mother of two daughters, but even now she remains loyal to her husband , this deep bound is common in our culture. Her only source of income is weaving handicrafts, which I found very interesting.

Despite all these difficulties, she remains hopeful about the future. She told me that, for the happiness of her daughters, she must work hard to give them a bright future. You can see the beauty, dignity, and resilience in her face.

nfts.name: Keys and Gates at Dominio PubliCC0
nfts.description:
Keys and Gates, the first edition of the 6529 Network Museum's first Accession Program, is on public exhibition at Casa NUA's Dominio PubliCC0 6529 gallery from August 20206.

Every society is organized by thresholds. Some are tangible: doors, borders, checkpoints, locks, fences. Others are embedded within bureaucracies, technologies, financial systems, and social conventions. Together, they shape the conditions of movement, participation, visibility, and belonging. They determine who may enter, who must wait, who is recognized, and who remains unseen.

Keys and Gates brings together photographic works selected through an open accession process for the inaugural photography program of the 6529 Network Museum. Participation in the program meant relinquishing all rights to the photographs and giving them permanently to the public domain under teh Creative Commons Zero license (CC0). Thus, each image functions simultaneously as an individual work and as part of a growing public archive, one that records the lived experience of sovereignty, self-custody, exclusion, mobility, and participation in the twenty-first century.

Rather than advancing a singular curatorial thesis, the exhibition assembles a constellation of perspectives on access, control, autonomy, and the right to choose one's own path. Each artist approaches the notion of the key differently: as an object, a gesture, a memory, an identity, a testimonial, an act of resistance, or a possibility waiting to be unlocked. Likewise, every gate reveals the visible and invisible systems that regulate our lives more than just physical barriers.

Across these works, thresholds emerge in many forms. They appear in borders and institutions, in architectures of surveillance and permission, in infrastructures of finance and technology, and in the intimate spaces where personal agency is quietly negotiated. Some photographs confront these systems directly; others approach them through metaphor, symbolism, or the subtle traces they leave upon everyday experience. Together, they propose that freedom is rarely encountered as an abstract ideal, but as a series of moments in which access is granted, withheld, challenged, or reclaimed.

Presented by Casa NUA at Domínio PúbliCC0, a space dedicated to bringing decentralized art and culture into the public realm, Keys and Gates extends these questions beyond the digital sphere. It invites us to consider every threshold, physical or symbolic, as a site where authority is exercised, negotiated, and, at times, transformed. Thus, the exhibition asks a question that resonates across every image: who holds the key, and what new worlds become possible when more people do?

"Acesso e Controle", on public exhibition  reaffirms Dominio PubliCC0's radical commitment to unrestricted access to culture and education about art and technology, bringing a new layer to photography diffusion by harnessing the power of web3.

This Meme Card celebrates and records on our world computer the first IRL exhibition of 6529 Network Museum works, and is part of Casa NUA's ongoing fundraiser for operating our public access gallery serving thousands of monthly visitors while giving them their first contact with networked art. The soundtrack, just like for our Pebbles exhibition meme card, was composed by Eric Pan for the upcoming Formosa Vinyl Record (stay tuned, it's in the works...!)

nfts.name: THE BUILDER
nfts.description:
I

You, who would sooner build, than read a manifesto: good.

The loudest aren't the builders.

They've always been too busy:

We still can't say how the pyramids rose from sand: 4,000 years and their secrets stay enshrined.
Sagrada Família topped its tallest spires this year, 144 years after laying the first stone.
Humankind's most-perfect mirror unfurls a million miles out from Earth, catching the universe's first glint.
(Our boosters now land themselves, to fly again and again.)
A country under fire assembles an air force from hobby parts, faster than the empire beside it can send tanks.
The lab grows a heart valve from one human's own cells.
And a few thousand coders keep a World Computer no one owns humming along for years at 100% uptime.

II

Making houses for each other on different scales...is one identical act.

We're under construction, endless.

No artifact is finished; this work is the same.

(And game recognize game.)

Here's a stage for the humblest builder of them all: a redeemer who ships work day after day.

A beaver.

The highest form of creation, after all, is creating room for more.

III

This is the first card of a deck.

Free to keep, free to copy.

A collection you can hold, and shuffle, and divine.

It's also a score we can hear, with friends beside us.

Something you can finally put in the hands of the people you love, and show them what you've been part of all this time.

A way to say what this is all worth (without numbers or acronyms).

Made to reach people who'll never touch a wallet.

And if you build, it comes from you, too.

nfts.name: PEBBLES at Domínio PúbliCC0
nfts.description:
SEIXOS (PEBBLES) is the third curation of Dominio PubliCC0, the 6529 gallery operated by Casa NUA in São Paulo, Brazil, and the first to present an entire CC0 generative art collection to audiences IRL: the 1,000 Pebbles, created by the artist duo ZeBlocks (Arsonic and Cheaterflums) on NextGen, 6529's on-chain generative art platform. Where the previous curation celebrated 6529 Memes as cultural units built to replicate and spread, this one asks the visitor to slow down before something that looks simple — pebbles, the smooth, rounded stones that time and water polish — and to find, in that simplicity, one of the most radical gestures in the art of our time.

NextGen is the on-chain generative art contract developed by the 6529 network: a piece of public infrastructure designed so that artists can launch algorithmic collections whose code and generative logic live on the Ethereum blockchain itself, with no dependence on private servers. More than a technical tool, NextGen belongs to 6529's wider cultural project — to build public goods and to strengthen a decentralized, open, censorship-resistant art ecosystem and coordination layer for networked societies. Pebbles, with its 1,000 works, is the platform's very first collection, minted February 2024. Shown at Dominio PubliCC0 under the CC0 license, it joins 6529's technical vanguard to Casa NUA's mission: to bring decentralized digital art to as many people as possible.

Described by the artists themselves as a project that explores balance, rhythm, and emergence through algorithmic systems, each Pebble is born from a single algorithm written by the duo — a piece of code that, from a random seed recorded at the very moment the NFT is minted, scatters a set of rounded shapes, colors, and unrepeatable compositions across a fabric-like texture. The artists do not paint each work; they compose the system of rules that brings the works into being, and leave the rest to chance and to the people who mint them. The result is a dialogue between order and chaos: the rigid logic of the underlying grid coexists with the free distribution of the ellipses, just as in nature no stone is identical to another even though all obey the same physical laws. In this sense, Pebbles is a tribute to the beauty of natural simplicity, reinterpreted through a modernist gaze and the digital medium.

Like everything in Dominio PubliCC0's program, SEIXOS is an exhibition of works released entirely under CC0: by the artists' own choice, they belong to the public domain. Each of the 1,000 works can be downloaded in ultra-high resolution (up to 16K), copied, printed, remixed, and reused by anyone, including for commercial purposes, without asking permission and without paying anything. What hangs on the wall is not a reproduction guarded by scarcity, but a shared cultural good that the public is invited to take, transform, and pass on.

The curation is organized as a journey through the "anatomy" of a generative collection, revealing layer by layer what usually stays hidden beneath the surface of the image. It opens by explaining, in plain terms, what generative art is and how it is made. It then moves through the traits that compose each Pebble: twenty palettes with evocative names; five densities of color, from the faintest to the most drenched; seven sizes, from the smallest Craglet to the largest Mountlet; the presence or absence of outlines and borders; the way shapes overlap or stand apart; and the rare special elements that punctuate the set. Finally, it arrives at the question that defines this field: how rarity and value emerge within a collection where every work shares the same code.

Along the way, visitors can play with the traits to generate a new unique Pebble of their own and watch the algorithm compose a unique image in real time, standing at the exact point where code becomes art. By the end of the path, they have not only contemplated the thousand versions of these digital pebbles, but grasped the logic of an entire new field of art. A contest will also see a Pebble NFT, donated by ZeBlocks, be awarded to the most creative reuse of the public domain work by local artists, and several fine art prints raffled to visitors onboarded to the 6529 platform.

Curated by Hugo Faz and Casa NUA, SEIXOS reaffirms Dominio PubliCC0's radical commitment to unrestricted access to culture, to education about art and technology, and to nurturing the creative economy — a reminder that, sometimes, very small stones can move ideas of global scope.

This Meme Card celebrates and records on our world computer Pebbles' first IRL exhibit, and is part of Casa NUA's ongoing fundraiser for operating the gallery. Soundtrack composed by Eric Pan, from the upcoming Formosa Vinyl Record (stay tuned...!)

nfts.name: 6529 SVNDIAL
nfts.description: A bronze and stone sundial that tells one truth twice a day. Two anamorphic gnomons stand on the dial: a 6 whose shadow falls as a 5, and a 2 whose shadow falls as a 9. In daylight the stone always reads 6529, but only at 06:52:09 and 18:52:09 do the shadows seat perfectly in their carved recesses. At first light the dial says GM. At dusk it speaks its name. At night, sine sole sileo: without the sun, I am silent. The carvings are always there. The shadows make them true. The rim is engraved with the Memes contract address. The patina, pits and cracks are grown from the latest Ethereum block hash, so no two days weather alike. Tempus tenetur. Time, held.

This work honours those forced to survive failing systems.

Fiat currency is a sinking ship. Be free to transact without the shackles of a central bank controlled debt note.

This early release of the Filthy Fiat series encodes multiple narratives and vibes (left up to your interpretation) wrapped inside the story of Titanic. At face value it illustrates how the fiat-based currency system is a sinking ship. The ship is taken down by the memes of decentralization.

A nod to the movie and just as historically accurate as the film itself. Don’t worry, the Pepe lovers survived. They are frogs.

Historical context for the piece:  
April 15, 1912 – The Titanic disaster claimed over 1,500 lives, including three of the world's richest men: John Jacob Astor IV, Benjamin Guggenheim, and Isidor Straus, all of whom opposed a central bank in the U.S. Meanwhile, financier J.P. Morgan, a key figure in the Federal Reserve’s creation, canceled his trip last minute, sparking speculation that he intentionally avoided the doomed voyage.

Hodl on for Dear Life is based on the painting ‘The Swing’ by Jean-Honoré Fragonard.

Living as someone who owns crypto can be incredibly stressful. One day you’re drinking champagne because Bitcoin is worth over $100 000, the next you’ve woken up to find your memecoins are worthless and you might not be able to pay rent. 

How do we survive the incredible ups and downs of the bear and bull markets?  
We hodl. 
Regardless of what’s happening, we try to ignore the market and just hold on, like the very pink woman holding onto her swing.

Like her, we don’t let go. We don’t get greedy when things look good, we don’t jump off the swing when things look terrible.

We make good friends, we make and collect good art, we try to make good choices.

We don’t invest more than we can handle losing and for the rest, we hodl on for dear life, because in the end it’ll be worth it.

nfts.name: Token Access Predators
nfts.description:
The constant struggle between security and risk in the digital space brings the Three Address Protocol to life through a visual language of hands. Each hand represents a different type of wallet, showing the balance between accessibility and protection. The cold wallet, a frozen hand, rests in deep slumber, awakened only when needed. The warm wallet, soft with a half-open eye, remains cautiously aware, a middle ground between safety and usability. The hot wallet, steaming and restless, is fully engaged, always in motion but exposed to the greatest danger. Surrounded by predators, with long and crooked fingers constantly reaching toward what isn’t theirs. 

The exaggerated proportions play on the dual meaning of “light-fingered” in English and the Finnish word for thief, which directly translates to “long-nailed.” The composition is both a reflection of security habits and an open canvas for interpretation. Hands can be cold, hot, or somewhere in between, depending on how one navigates risk. In a world where threats never sleep, the question remains: how secure are your hands?

nfts.name: ONLY WINNERS SURVIVE
nfts.description:
Survival Bias is the logical error of concentrating on entities that passed a selection process while overlooking those that did not.

I started exploring this in the context of artists as a reflection on the digital art space, and the way that there is an elevation and magnification of the artists who are considered successes. The concentration of attention on the survivors is a natural result of their success. That does not change the way it feels to try and break through and achieve your own success in the shadows of such giants though. This piece speaks a rebuttal to the concept of WAGMI and instead gives another useless phrase “ONLY WINNERS SURVIVE” As untrue as the idea that we are all going to make it, Only Winners Survive is about the dark thoughts that live within us when we feel overlooked and undervalued. 

This piece is a dynamic work that contains over 65+ variants, each one is loaded randomly and in a random order. This random order is selected with weighted probability. So there is an element of chance to what you will see. This is actually a reinforcement of the theme. There are many factors that lead to success, and many that are the result of random events in conjunction with seizing opportunities. 

If you look at this on a computer you can type in some cheatcodes to find secret variants. The music that was included was all created by me, and each is a reinforcement of the themes within this card. Each visual variant utilises semiotics and variation to express different sets and settings of the theme. The music controls can be accessed by pressing the little music icon next to the fullscreen icon.

nfts.name: Here Lies
nfts.description:
This artwork critiques centralized power while celebrating the ideals of decentralization. The phrase “Hic Situs Imperium Centrale” is a creative adaptation of the Latin epitaph “Hic Situs Est,” meaning “Here Lies.” Traditionally found on Roman tombstones, it conveys finality and legacy. By adding “Imperium Centrale”—“Central Power”—the phrase symbolizes the burial of central authority, with the Roman Empire serving as a historical reference for such systems.

The tulip used in the composition resembles the Semper Augustus, the rarest and most valuable tulip in history. During the 17th-century Tulip Mania, it embodied wealth, greed, and colonial power. Although the original Semper Augustus is extinct, this tulip—found in the garden of Toronto’s City Hall—adds a playful and rebellious twist, subtly reclaiming control from institutional authority.

The composition is carefully designed with shadows connecting each element—the skull, vase, and tulip—creating a visual loop that guides the viewer’s gaze. The skull represents mortality, the vase symbolizes the rigidity of authority, the tulip reflects the fragility of beauty and power, and the shadows emphasize the inevitable connection between these concepts. Through this thoughtful arrangement, the artwork critiques control systems while embracing transformation, impermanence, and decentralized freedom.

nfts.name: Philosopher's Bitcoin
nfts.description:
"Philosopher's Bitcoin" is a meme representing the journey of discovering the ultimate key to the perfect cryptocurrency — a recipe for both financial and spiritual enlightenment. It symbolizes the modern-day alchemist's quest to unlock a secret formula for growth in both realms. This meme is said to bring luck in trading.

This concept draws inspiration from alchemy, specifically the Philosopher's Stone and the Rebis. The central figure combines both male and female elements, symbolizing the reconciliation of opposites — spirit and matter, logic and emotion. The meme is adorned with cryptographic symbols and blockchain-inspired patterns.

Philosopher's Bitcoin aligns with the "Freedom to Transact" theme. "The Search for the Perfect Coin" emphasizes how cryptocurrency serves as the vehicle for achieving this freedom, facilitating transactions without barriers and enabling individuals to exercise control over their financial interactions.

For context, alchemy aimed at both material and spiritual transformation. Practically, alchemists sought to transmute base metals into gold, discover the Philosopher's Stone — a substance that enables transmutation and grants immortality — and develop early forms of medicine. Spiritually, alchemy was about personal transformation, mirroring the process of purifying the soul through stages of growth. It also sought to reconcile opposites like spirit and matter, male and female, light and dark, to achieve balance.

The Rebis (from the Latin res bina, meaning "dual matter") is the end product of the alchemical magnum opus or Great Work. After undergoing stages of decay and purification, opposing qualities are separated and then reunited in what is often described as the divine hermaphrodite — a reconciliation of spirit and matter. This being embodies both male and female aspects, as symbolized by a single body with two heads, one male and one female.

Details like an embroidery of a unicorn, referencing Uniswap, and the planet Jupiter, symbolizing Solana traders, are incorporated to give nods to key elements in the crypto world. A gecko or salamander is also present, symbolizing both fire in alchemy and CoinGecko in crypto. These small symbols represent what makes a great trader — wisdom, foresight, and a deep connection to the market. 

The number seven, present in the meme, holds significant symbolic importance in alchemy, especially in the context of the Rebis. In alchemical tradition, seven often represents the completion of a cycle, spiritual transformation, and the harmony of opposites. Alchemy associates seven classical planets with seven corresponding metals. The Sun (Sol) is associated with gold, symbolizing purity and enlightenment, while the Moon (Luna) is linked to silver, representing intuition and the feminine principle. Mercury (Mercurius) is tied to the metal mercury (quicksilver), symbolizing transformation and the union of spirit and matter. Venus corresponds to copper, symbolizing beauty and harmony, while Mars is linked to iron, representing strength and masculine energy. Jupiter is associated with tin, symbolizing wisdom and growth, and Saturn corresponds to lead, representing transformation and the base material to be purified. These seven elements must be harmonized and transmuted during the alchemical process.

nfts.name: Place All Your Bets
nfts.description:
"Scared Money Don't Make Money" - Billy Napier

I've always viewed life as a game of predictions, calculations, and a final reliance on luck. "Place All Your Bets" embodies this mindset, encouraging you to bet on yourself and reach the high-stakes tables where the real game begins.

The artwork portrays a casino scene filled with familiar faces, reflecting the web3 art community — a world where grit is essential for survival. At the center stands the devil’s advocate, grinning despite not knowing the second card, confident in his house edge. Yet, the other players share the same smile, understanding the game and thus leveling the playing field.

This piece captures the thrill and adrenaline of "The Game," where participants must analyze, predict, and hope for luck to win big. They are here because they love the game. So, "Place All Your Bets," but remember — never split 10s.

**100 = QVL ("kol"), meaning "voice" or "sound" in Hebrew, suggesting the importance of expression and communication.  
**100 = The total value of all integers between 1 and 13, indicating a complete cycle or journey.  
**100 = CENTURY, a representation of a hundred years, suggesting longevity and endurance.  
**100 = The Roman numeral C, signifying "complete" or "closed loop," indicating wholeness or unity.

nfts.name: The Suits
nfts.description:
The artwork portrays a deeper meaning of the invasion of traditional financial institutions, clarifying the clash between traditional finance and cryptocurrency, personified by the protagonist's struggle against encroaching "suits." The loud warning of "The suits are coming" underscores the threat of institutional control, especially with the recent approval of Bitcoin ETFs.

As the protagonist traverses through blockchain networks, defending their cryptocurrency holdings, the piece emphasizes the need for autonomy against regulation. The journey through different eras symbolizes the volatility of the crypto market, highlighting the challenges investors face.

The scene featuring Gary Gensler's head atop a gigantic robot commanding an army of suits serves as a playful and exaggerated (or not) representation of the regulatory authority's involvement in the cryptocurrency space.

The final revelation of staged visual effects not only underscores the need to discern reality from illusion but also serves as a cautionary tale against scams and false narratives in the crypto space.

“Carpe GM”, 2024 by Rebecca Rose. 3D digital Collage, dimensions: 1080x1080 at 155.4mb, duration: 0:52.

This piece is the 6529 Meme Card Collection's season 6 finale, and is part of the artist’s ongoing series “DeepCuts”, 3D collages with depth inspired by songs. The soundtrack is edited by the artist and contains excerpts from “Captain Shepherd’s Quickstep, a public domain piece from 1850 recorded by the Library of Congress in 1974. Musical citation: Grafulla, Claudio S., composer. Fennell, Frederick, conductor. “Captain Shepherd’s Quickstep.” Sound recording. Washington, DC: The Library of Congress Recording Laboratory, September 1974. From Library of Congress, Our Musical Past. Rebecca Rose is an award winning collage artist exploring collaged sculpts and holograms. Her 20+ year body of analog, sculptural, and digital collage has received multiple major artist grants co-sponsored by The Robert Rauschenberg Foundation, The Andy Warhol Foundation, The Joan Mitchell Foundation, The Willem de Kooning Foundation, The Andrew Mellon Foundation, The Ford Foundation, and Bloomberg Philanthropic.

nfts.name: Ode to the Buidlers
nfts.description:
"Ode to the Buidlers" is a card created with a photographic technique known as "Photogrammetry." Photogrammetry involves scanning an areaand converting the photos and video into 3D points (aka point cloud). Those points are then rendered in a 3D program and editing, lighting, and other effects are added to create the final piece.

The entire process took around 2 months to complete, as I had to build the stage for the card. The hardest part was actually contacting the various buidlers in the space to ask for their permission to use their PFPs in the card. Some of the buidlers I was able to successfully contact were: 

1) Punk 6529  
2) Richerd - Manifold  
3) Pravjin - Deca  
4) Justin Trimble - Stability AI  
5) Ben Strauss - Transient Labs  
6) Snowfro - Artblocks  
7) Claire Silver - Accelerate Art  
8) Rayan - Oncyber  
9) Fonz - Tokenproof 
10) Norcalguy - ClickCreate

I was then able to order poster-sized prints of their PFPs. After obtaining the prints, I scouted for an area that fit my parameters for a successful scan. This part took me an entire day from morning until night. It is very difficult, because finding the perfect area will determine if the card will be loopable or not. Once I decided on the location, I came back on a different day, put up the posters, scanned the area, and then proceeded to the next month's work of editing and production. I also invested in a beefier video card for the sole purpose of creating this card.

I wanted to create a card that demonstrated my effort and dedication to the Memes. Not only high effort but also something new and different with a theme. The location this was shot at is Euljiro, Seoul, South Korea. This is an area where metal shop workers build components used in everyday machines and electronics. Not only that, but the sound recorded on the spot is also of the metal shop workers at their craft. And the PFPs are people who contribute to the web3 space with DApps we use in our everyday life.

Finally, the small blocks created through this technique can also be thought of as "The Buidler's Blocks."

nfts.name: Vital Energy
nfts.description:
"Vital Energy" is a piece of art that captivates the imagination with its visual narrative and its emotive message. The protagonist of this story is a child named Jonny Boy, a curious and adventurous soul who transcends the limitations of reality.   
   
The artwork opens with Jonny Boy gracefully soaring amidst the clouds, arms spread wide like wings, his gaze filled with wonder and fear at the same time. This image symbolizes childhood, a time of discovery and uncertainty where every moment is a new adventure.   
   
However, the scene takes an unexpected turn when Jonny Boy is struck by a cascade of arrows materializing out of nowhere.  This detail emphasizes that even when Jonny Boy faces challenges and obstacles, he must maintain faith in himself and his journey. JonnyBoy represents each of us struggling and enduring to improve this difficult world.    
   
I dedicated this work to WAGMI because this phrase is magical, it unites people in a feeling of belonging and mutual support. When you say or share this acronym, you create a bond with others who share the same spirit of determination and confidence in the future.

nfts.name: God Save The Key
nfts.description:
“God Save The Key” by artist YuYu takes a spin on renaissance masterpieces to humourlessly remind us the importance of self sovereignty - Not your Keys, Not your coins. YuYu's reinterpretation of Jacques-Louis David's painting The Oath of the Horatii (1786) draws inspiration from the three depicted brothers and their unity, reflecting the collective efforts of the web3 community to defend and uphold its ethos.   
   
Additionally, the artwork combines elements from Karl Brullov's The Last Day of Pompeii (1833), lighting with its eruption the left corner of the background, and Briton Riviere's lions from Daniel's Answer to the King (1892) encircle the main character, serving as indicators of imminent danger. Through these conceptual elements, the work depicts the turbulent nature of cryptocurrency while emphasizing the vital role of unity and collective action in fortifying decentralization.  
   
Artworks used:   
1. The Oath of the Horatii 1786 - Jacques-Louis David   
2. The Last Day of Pompeii 1833 - Karl Brullov   
3. Daniel's Answer To The King 1892 - Briton Riviere

nfts.name: Converging Chaos #49
nfts.description: Converging Chaos marks a turning point. While it still carries traces of my previous visual language, this piece represents a deeper evolution in my practice — a shift toward something freer, rougher, and more instinctive. It’s not a break from who I was, but a natural progression. The chaos here is a creative force coming together.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #49
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #49
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #49

Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. The red porcelain skeletons represent the fragility of origin and the permanence of intent—one hand reaching forward, the other designed with six fingers, a deliberate anomaly symbolizing unnatural evolution and the mutation of control.
In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

"Short Change Hero", 2025, by Rebecca Rose. 3d spatially collaged digital animation, dimensions: 1920x1080, duration: 0:40. Original soundtrack composed with AI assistance and sound mixing by the artist.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #49
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #48
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #47
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #47
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #46

Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. nfts.name: Abiogenesis #46
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #44
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #44
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #44

Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #43
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

While it still carries traces of my previous visual language, this piece represents a deeper evolution in my practice — a shift toward something freer, rougher, and more instinctive. nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #42
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #42
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #42
nfts.description:
Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. The red porcelain skeletons represent the fragility of origin and the permanence of intent—one hand reaching forward, the other designed with six fingers, a deliberate anomaly symbolizing unnatural evolution and the mutation of control.
In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

nfts.name: Short Change Hero #42
nfts.description:
"Short Change Hero", 2025, by Rebecca Rose. 3d spatially collaged digital animation, dimensions: 1920x1080, duration: 0:40. Original soundtrack composed with AI assistance and sound mixing by the artist.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. The red porcelain skeletons represent the fragility of origin and the permanence of intent—one hand reaching forward, the other designed with six fingers, a deliberate anomaly symbolizing unnatural evolution and the mutation of control.
In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

nfts.description:

stories became paintings, paintings became pixels.

The ladder we climb isn’t just history it’s proof we were here.
From cave walls to code, our legacy continues.

nfts.description:
"Short Change Hero", 2025, by Rebecca Rose. 3d spatially collaged digital animation, dimensions: 1920x1080, duration: 0:40. Original soundtrack composed with AI assistance and sound mixing by the artist.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #41
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #40
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #40
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #39
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #37
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #37
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #37

Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #36
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

While it still carries traces of my previous visual language, this piece represents a deeper evolution in my practice — a shift toward something freer, rougher, and more instinctive. nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #35
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #35
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #35
nfts.description:
Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. The red porcelain skeletons represent the fragility of origin and the permanence of intent—one hand reaching forward, the other designed with six fingers, a deliberate anomaly symbolizing unnatural evolution and the mutation of control.
In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

The ladder we climb isn’t just history it’s proof we were here.
From cave walls to code, our legacy continues.

nfts.name: Short Change Hero #35
nfts.description:
"Short Change Hero", 2025, by Rebecca Rose. 3d spatially collaged digital animation, dimensions: 1920x1080, duration: 0:40. Original soundtrack composed with AI assistance and sound mixing by the artist.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #34
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #33
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #33
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #32
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #30
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #30
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.

nfts.name: 𝕲𝖊𝖓𝖊𝖘𝖎𝖘: The Creation Of AI #30

Inspired by Michelangelo’s The Creation of Adam, this piece reimagines the divine moment—not as a blessing from god to man, but as a data transfer from human to machine. Rendered in meticulous pixel art and permanently inscribed on the blockchain, it marks a turning point in digital art history: a genesis not of flesh, but of code. In an age where intelligence is sculpted, not born, this image captures a paradox we can no longer ignore:
Creation now mirrors us, but does not need us.

Are heroes even possible in a world where everyone is flawed? And why are we so quick to discard them once they’ve fallen from grace, off a towering pedestal that we ourselves built?

"Short Change Hero" is about disillusionment with those we place on pedestals, rooted in human imperfection and our tendency to idealize others. We project onto them qualities that align with our values, hopes, aspirations, desires, dreams. It becomes less about the person and more about our individual need for symbols of greatness... for something to believe in. But when the facade cracks, simply through exposure of their humanity and imperfections, we’re left grappling with disappointment, betrayal, and our own cynicism. Because we just can't tolerate it.

nfts.name: Abiogenesis #29
nfts.description:
Abiogenesis is a meditative pixel art piece exploring the metaphor of life's origins through the birth of a single pixel. Set within a tranquil, greenish-blue pond, the artwork reimagines the concept of primordial creation where stillness gives way to movement, and existence unfolds from nothingness. Here, water becomes more than a setting; it’s the primordial canvas where energy first finds form.

Renowned in the pixel art community as a master of water ripples and reflections, I designed this piece using seven distinct layers of animated water behavior, each with its own unique reflection style. The artwork is a 20-frame, hand-drawn animated GIF that loops seamlessly, built with a limited palette of just 15 carefully chosen colors. This controlled palette and layered animation technique create a deep visual richness while maintaining the minimalist integrity of pixel art. Abiogenesis is both an aesthetic and technical exploration, a reflection on how life, like art, begins with a single point of emergence.

nfts.name: Attentional Dynamics #28
nfts.description:
Made in 2021 with sampling of OpenSea historical data. This was just a draft at the time exploring the history of NFTs on Ethereum. The visualization is a dynamic word cloud. Each date is rendered with the names of prominent NFT projects, font size proportional to volume each day from 2018 to late 2021, from the kitties to the on-chain text SVGs. Slow, suddenly, suddenlier. These visual dynamics intrigued me. They highlight our space’s tendency then and still to focus like an attentional flock on a concentrated set of winners. And around these winners, a frantic expansion of the space, others seeking a slice of that attention. This pattern is not unique to crypto. Such attentional dynamics seem natural to socioeconomic systems. Crypto reflects them and makes it easy to measure them. I never contemplated minting back when I created this, but looking back, the way it "burns out" in the last few seconds also expresses how the market could feel. I submit this animation as-is: It derives directly from those feelings then, feelings probably shared by many at the time.

Two versions were made, they can be viewed here:

takenstheorem.github.io/dam-submission

nfts.name: "Innerland #1" #28
nfts.description:
Innerland is an ongoing series of portraits capturing artists from around the world—those who dare to look into their own souls and connect with the deepest parts of their psyche.

   Depicting a statement that human is more than what we see with our eyes, the project aims to discover an endless world that is held inside, rather than outer facade. Acknowledging that we spend most of our lives within our subconscious—immersed in thoughts, emotions, and dreams—the artist reflects on the paradox of how connected or disconnected from nature each person is, despite being an intrinsic part of it themselves.

   Developing a new art genre called ‘Staged Documentary’ and shying away from more classical definition of portrait, human beings are shown as such having no definite borders, and no rational shape. They are continuation of the environment itself, as the environment forms them a lot, and vice versa - they form the environment.

Aiming to build an extensive photographic archive of creatives across various artistic disciplines, Tania perceives her subjects as souls rather than bodies defined by physical attributes. In the eyes of the universe, they all are equal—infinitely deep, boundless, and eternal, existing beyond the constraints of the material world. Her artworks seek to offer an abstract representation of the delicate inner landscape of a human being, pioneering the concept of Inner World Portraiture—a departure from traditional portraiture, where physical appearance often takes center stage.
